headline: ERYKAH BADU'S NEW ALBUM ARRIVES FRIDAY
caption:
Erykah Badu's first studio album in 16 years arrives August 28 as a full collaboration with The Alchemist. Recorded across 18 months in Dallas and Los Angeles, the project is preceded by the new single Witch Doctor and will be followed by a North American tour.

Source: Control FREAQ Records and Young Recordings
